title: Introducing Yourself in an Interview
author: Hive
intro: 这一课是面试开场的自我介绍：先致谢，再说明背景和优势，讲一个自己做过的项目，最后表达求职意愿并向面试官提问。说话人是初级软件开发者，朗读时把每一段当作一次完整的表达。
tips: 讲项目时放慢语速，把技术名词和数字读清楚。
开头和结尾的客套话要自然带笑意，不要像在念稿。
segments: Thank you for having me today. I'm really glad to be here, and I appreciate the chance to meet your team.
My name is Alex, and I'm a junior software developer with about two years of experience in web development.
I graduated last year with a degree in computer science, and since then I've been working on front-end projects at a small startup.
I'd say my biggest strength is that I learn quickly. When I don't know something, I look it up, try it out, and ask questions early.
I'm also pretty organized, so I usually write down my tasks and check them every morning.
One project I'm proud of is a small app that helps our team track bug reports. I built the backend, and I designed the simple dashboard.
The hardest part was handling a lot of data at once. I solved it by adding a queue, and the page now loads about three times faster.
I'm looking for a role where I can keep growing as a developer. Your team's work really interests me.
Could I ask a question about the team? How do new developers usually get started here?
Thank you for your time. I'd love to hear more about the next steps.
